title: Long-code experiment value
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, let a finite-seed tester specify a sign-valued predicate check for each seed, and let a long-code table be given. The experiment value is the expected value of the check's acceptance indicator, when the sample is drawn from the law of the long-code experiment determined by $G$, the tester, and the table.
hypotheses_covered: A regular unique game $G$ with alphabet size $q$
A long-code table on the vertices of $G$
